In 2017, I made it officially my home. I wanted to bring a more affordable, fun, and casual dining experience to the Gulf Coast so I opened Wacked Out Weiner in Gulf Shores on March 1, 2018. The response has been AMAZING! Winning several awards (including "Best Hot Dog Joint in Alabama") has been the second most thing that I am proud of. The first being the relationship with our customers, our community, and our local school system. Becoming "the locAL hot dog joint of PARADISE" has been fun and exciting. I can't wait to see what the Good Lord has in store for the future! Check out our store on our Facebook page 'Wacked Out Weiner Gulf Shores' below for our merchandise. Check Us Out on Facebook HUNGRY?
